title: Word wrap
prompt: Write `wrapText(text, width)`: greedy word wrap. Split text on single spaces, pack words greedily into lines of at most `width` characters (the joining spaces count; a word longer than width gets its own line, unbroken). Return the array of lines; empty text gives an empty array. Reply with exactly one JavaScript code block (```js ... ```) that uses `export function` for the required function. ES module syntax, no external imports, no I/O, no comments needed.
